message: Here are 6 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Tall uneven stack of boxes
hazards.description: In the center of the image, cardboard boxes are stacked very high on a single pallet against the wall with uneven upper tiers, so boxes could topple onto workers passing through the busy dock area.

hazards.title: Heavy panel carried alone, vision blocked
hazards.description: A worker in the center is carrying a large sheet-metal panel alone in front of their body, which blocks their forward view and creates a strain risk while walking through an area with a hose, pallets and other workers.

hazards.title: Stepladder in doorway, overhead reach
hazards.description: On the right, a worker stands high on a blue stepladder set up in a doorway, reaching overhead toward the door frame, with the ladder positioned in a traffic path.

hazards.title: Pallet jack moving heavy units in trailer
hazards.description: Inside the trailer on the left, a worker is handling heavy condenser units with a pallet jack while another worker stands near the trailer opening, risking struck-by or caught-between injuries if a load shifts or rolls.

hazards.title: Hose across walkway and doorway
hazards.description: A red hose runs across the floor from near the box stack, through the doorway toward the stepladder on the right, creating a trip hazard in a main walkway.

hazards.title: Pallets and equipment crowding walkway
hazards.description: In the left foreground, wrapped equipment and an empty wooden pallet sit at the edge of the walking path, narrowing the travel route and creating a trip hazard.
